quarterly_data.signal: The Q2 2026 10-Q shows TRIKAFTA/KAFTRIO revenue down 2% year over year while ALYFTREK grew 266%, other CF product revenues fell 29%, CASGEVY grew 151% and JOURNAVX 313%. For the first six months of 2026 ALYFTREK revenue was $998.0 million (+374%) and TRIKAFTA/KAFTRIO $4,851.9 million (-5%). Cost of sales as a percentage of net product revenues increased to 14.7% from 13.8% in Q2 2025 as a result of changes in product mix, partially offset by a lower blended royalty rate for CF medicines.
